Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking time on Monday to walk through AlphaMetrics' latency-sensitive recommendation workload. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

What we heard
- Goal: reduce per-inference cost while keeping 95th pct latency <= 100ms for user-facing recommendations.
- Current infra: self-hosted model infra on GCP with a mix of GPUs; considering a hybrid approach for peak traffic.
- Constraints: procurement window closes end of Q2 (you mentioned 6/30), security review required (SOC2 + audit logs), and data residency for EU customers.

Success criteria for POC
- Serve your top-5 models at target latency under realistic traffic (95th <= 100ms)
- Demonstrate 25-40% cost reduction per-1M tokens compared to current baseline
- Deliver an eval run + load test and a short report your infra team can review

Proposed next steps
1) Share a short mutual action plan (attached) and pricing quote (attached).
2) Quick technical kickoff: 30m with your infra lead to validate network/KMS access and quantization constraints (Marissa from our side will join).
3) Security questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 evidence and a short runbook for audit logs.
4) Procurement: if the POC meets criteria, we can prepare a standard term sheet for review by procurement.

Can you confirm: 1) Is procurement timeline still 6/30? 2) Who should be on the technical kickoff from your infra team?

Happy to hop on a quick call — I can be flexible this week.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

aditya@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
